name: Shall Wither
source:
Though a man of few words, he often speaks in a way that puts distance between him and the person he's talking to. Because of that, he's easily misunderstood, but he's also got a caring side to him. At the theater, he's renowned as a "star actor" and regularly invites the audience into the world of dreams using his extraordinary magic skills.

[Translated from [url=https://comic.iowl.jp/games/veribaro/shall]official website[/url]]
